## Reward-model prompts by source

From **Table 6** (page 33):

| Split | Labeler-written | Customer (API) | Total |
|---|---|---|---|
| Train | 6,623 | 26,584 | 33,207 |
| Validation | 3,488 | 14,399 | 17,887 |

So the RM **training** set had **6,623 labeler-written prompts** and **26,584 customer prompts** (page 33). This is consistent with the main text, which says the RM dataset has "33k training prompts (from the API and labeler-written)" (page 7). It also matches the RM train count of 33,207 in Table 9 (page 34).

The number of comparisons the reward model was trained on is about ten times larger than the prompt counts. For each prompt, labelers ranked K = 4 to 9 outputs, and the model was trained on all pairwise comparisons from each ranking (page 33).
